title: DATA SCIENCE & DATA ANALYTICS FACULTY
description:
**WE'RE HIRING – DATA SCIENCE & DATA ANALYTICS FACULTY**

**BIT – Baroda Institute of Technology, Gandhinagar**

Location: Infocity, Gandhinagar, Gujarat  
Position: Full-Time Faculty / Technical Trainer  
Experience: 1–3 years  
Salary: Negotiable based on skills and experience

**Required Skills:**

* Python, NumPy, Pandas and Statistics
* SQL and Database Management
* Excel, Advanced Excel and Power BI
* Data Cleaning, Analysis and Visualization
* Machine Learning and Scikit-learn
* Generative AI and practical projects

**Responsibilities:**

* Conduct practical classroom sessions.
* Guide students through live projects and assignments.
* Teach Data Analytics and Data Science concepts.
* Support students with technical interviews and career preparation.

**Candidate Profile:** Candidates with industry experience, teaching experience and strong practical knowledge are encouraged to apply.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume, expected salary and notice period.
